## Electron Spin

::: columns

::: {.column width="50%"}

### Angular momentum

$$
\hat{S}^2 |s,m_s\rangle
= \hbar^2 s(s+1)|s,m_s\rangle
$$

$$
\hat{S}_z |s,m_s\rangle
= \hbar m_s |s,m_s\rangle
$$

For an electron:

$$
\boxed{s=\frac{1}{2},\qquad m_s=\pm\frac{1}{2}}
$$

. . .

$$
|\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\rangle =|\uparrow\rangle =
\begin{pmatrix}
1\\
0
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
|\frac{1}{2},-\frac{1}{2}\rangle =|\downarrow\rangle =
\begin{pmatrix}
0\\
1
\end{pmatrix}
$$

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

### Spin operators

$$
\hat{S}_x
=
\frac{\hbar}{2}
\begin{pmatrix}
0&1\\
1&0
\end{pmatrix}
\qquad
\hat{S}_y
=
\frac{\hbar}{2}
\begin{pmatrix}
0&-i\\
i&0
\end{pmatrix}
$$

$$
\hat{S}_z
=
\frac{\hbar}{2}
\begin{pmatrix}
1&0\\
0&-1
\end{pmatrix}
$$

. . .

Just like orbital angular momentum,

$$
\boxed{
[\hat{S}_i,\hat{S}_j]
=
i\hbar\,\epsilon_{ijk}\hat{S}_k
}
$$

:::

:::
